description: Trafikkdata fra Bane NOR is a dataset listed in National Data Catalog of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bane nor sf. Jernbaneverket tilbyr eksterne brukere å benytte deler av innholdet for trafikkinformasjon på internettsidene. Det betyr at informasjon om togtrafikken kan gjøres tilgjengelig i eksterne tjenester uten at det betales for dette. Dette er data som viser rutetider og sanntidsinformasjon om togtrafikken. Coverage: Norway. The publisher named on the listing is Bane nor sf. Its keywords include tog, jernbane, togtrafikk. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2018-01-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-norge-no.
